{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue type and example values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA test orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA test orders: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")
print(f"QA order IDs: {qa_orders['order_id'].tolist()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded.shape[0]}")

# Display unique values for channel and customer_segment
print(f"Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique customer_segment: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")"}
